verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a token-authenticated REST API, official type-safe SDKs, and bulk-automation and data-push endpoints. Together these let scripts and pipelines drive the product headlessly without the UI. However, nothing documents a CLI, a CI-specific integration such as a GitHub Action, or an example of running it inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration, documented CI/pipeline usage guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
